T77c done - root-cause fix for T77b A2 landed, compileall clean, targeted suites green except the documented oc-issues #34 env failure, no commit (per task spec).

WHAT CHANGED
(1) app/services/sessions/turn.py (+17): before build_chat_messages, the turn now queries the EXISTING conn - SELECT id, kind, question FROM quiz_questions WHERE session_id = ? AND status = 'pending' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 10 - and sets lesson_state['pending_questions'] = [{id, kind, question truncated to 140 chars} per row]. The uuids that previously lived only inside the ephemeral role:'tool' message of the run_probe turn are now re-derived from the DB on EVERY subsequent turn. Also _tool_result_summary gained one branch: a non-blank embedded result['summary'] string is surfaced verbatim as the SSE tool_result summary, so successful grading is observable by SSE consumers (closes the T77b minor observation about summary='').
(2) app/llm/messages.py (+18): build_lesson_state_block appends, only when pending questions exist: '[PENDING QUESTIONS] The learner still owes answers to these. Grade each reply against these EXACT ids (copy id character-for-character):' followed by one line per item '- id=<id> (<kind>) <question>'; renders nothing when none pending (verified absent pre-probe). PHASE_PLAYBOOK probe section gains 'Present EVERY question returned by run_probe — never silently drop any.' (directly targets the T77b silent-skip of probe item 3183...). Remediation guidance in check_due gains 'Remediation style: Re-explain from a different angle; do NOT repeat your previous check question wording verbatim — ask a fresh one targeting the same gap.' (targets T77b's verbatim-repeat observation).
(3) app/llm/tools.py (+26): new _summarize(name, result) returning 'probe ready: N questions', 'graded <outcome>', 'plan ready: N nodes', advance_lesson -> 'advanced to <node title>' / 'remediation' / 'lesson complete'; execute_tool now wraps a renamed _dispatch_tool and stamps result['summary'] on SUCCESS ONLY (error dicts untouched, generate_*/web_search/record_step_actions untouched per brief). The summary rides into the model-visible role:'tool' JSON and via turn.py into the SSE tool_result event.
(4) tests/test_tools_loop.py (+2): test_execute_tool_grade_answer_passthrough's exact-key set assertion gains 'summary' plus assert graded['summary'] == 'graded correct'.
(5) tests/test_api_chat_sse.py (+87): lesson-state test extended with a scripted run_probe turn (scripted complete_json probe array + script_tool_events run_probe) followed by an answer turn; asserts probe tool_result summary == 'probe ready: 3 questions', extracts the real server-generated probe id from the role:'tool' payload, and asserts the answer-turn system prompt contains '[PENDING QUESTIONS]', the exact header line, '- id=<uuid> (probe)', and the playbook string 'Present EVERY question returned by run_probe'; also asserts '[PENDING QUESTIONS]' absent from the first-turn prompt.
